## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Scope

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Refactor
- [ ] Security / privacy
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Infrastructure / CI/CD
- [ ] Other

## Verification

List the exact commands, environments, and results. Do not claim checks that were not run.

- [ ] Unit / integration / end-to-end tests
- [ ] Lint / format / type checks
- [ ] Build / package verification
- [ ] Security / dependency review (when relevant)
- [ ] Manual UX / device / browser verification (when relevant)

## Risk and rollout

Describe compatibility, data migrations, operational impact, feature flags, rollout, monitoring, and rollback/forward-recovery.

## Security and privacy

Describe changed trust boundaries, permissions, data handling, secrets, and threat-model considerations. Confirm no secrets or private customer data are included.

## Evidence

Add screenshots, logs with sensitive data redacted, benchmarks, or other supporting evidence where relevant.
